lead_intake.name: Lead Intake Process
steps: 1. Receive lead information (email, referral, form, etc.)
2. Sales Agent scores the lead on Fit, Budget, Timing, Authority (1-10 each)
3. Calculate overall score and assign verdict (HOT/WARM/COLD)
5. Present to owner for review and approval
7. Send the reply and log in the pipeline

client_onboarding.name: Client Onboarding Process
steps: 2. Create client vault in memory system
4. Run onboarding checklist (kickoff meeting, contract, access, preferences)
6. Store all client information in vault

pricing_request.name: Pricing Request Process
steps: 2. Negotiation Agent reviews rate card and client context
4. Present options to owner with recommendation
6. Send final pricing to client via Client Agent
